english.meaning: to work, switch on or hit the mark
english.note: 着唔着 asks whether it works or not. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: He’s just seeing if it turns on—that’s called testing it, right?
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢試下着唔着又叫做試機𡃉喇嗎。
